scripts.build:web: bun build src/bootstrap.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --minify --define process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' && cp src/index.html dist/index.html
scripts.build:benchmark: bun run build:web && ../../../scripts/with-local-rust.sh tauri build --bundles app && bun scripts/package-benchmark.ts
scripts.test: bun run build:web && ../../../scripts/with-local-rust.sh cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
